participant_roles: ConcreteSubject=AuthService.currentUserSubject (RxJS BehaviorSubject); Subject API=AuthService.currentUser$; Observer=RxJS subscription callback; ConcreteObservers=NavbarComponent.ngOnInit and HomeComponent.ngOnInit
intent_and_evidence: AuthService owns a BehaviorSubject, exposes it as an Observable, and emits user-state values. NavbarComponent and HomeComponent subscribe and update their local view state when emitted. The collaboration is confirmed, with a baseline consistency flaw: LoginComponent writes localStorage directly and logout removes storage without emitting null, so the subject can become stale.
